s.note: Chilli, cheese and onion hot dogs.
s.how: Brown the mince with the spices, add the tomatoes and simmer until thick. Grill the franks until blistered and toast the rolls. Fill, spoon over the chilli and top with cheese and onion.

s.note: A tangle of crisp onion with ranch dip.
s.how: Soak the onion in the buttermilk for 10 minutes. Toss handfuls in the flour mixed with paprika and salt and fry at 180C until golden. Stir the chipotle through the mayo and serve with the hot onions piled high.

m.note: Pepperoni pizza cut into petals. Alex opens the Death Blossom.
m.how: Stretch the dough into 2 rounds on oiled trays. Spread with passata, sprinkle with oregano and top with mozzarella, pepperoni and capsicum. Bake at 250C until blistered, then cut each into 8 long petal slices from the centre out.

m.note: Seared steak, fried onions and cheese on a roll.
m.how: Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft and sweet. Season and sear the steak 3 minutes a side, rest, then slice thinly. Split and toast the rolls, spread with mustard and pile on steak, onions, cheese and rocket.

w.n: Green moon of Galan key lime pie
w.note: Sharp lime custard in a crumb crust with whipped cream.
w.how: Crush the biscuits, mix with the butter and press into a 22cm pie tin. Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime zest and 125ml lime juice until thick. Pour into the base and bake at 160C until just set, then chill. Whip the cream and spoon on top with more zest.

d.note: Root beer over two scoops of vanilla.
d.how: Put two scoops of ice cream in each of 4 tall glasses. Pour the root beer slowly down the side so it foams up.
